about: dev3 · The Form Room (round 4, written for the third held-out brief’s types): the writer’s notebook (Aldhelm Notes: People) says chemistry and Year Ten, the prose biology and Year Eleven: both Which is right?; a letter read out with no quotation marks (Dear … Yours in faith) claims the school never closed, the narration says it closed twice; Ch 2 gives the Great Hall’s assembly another time, the science block another neighbour (both may hold: worth a look at most) and Mr Wilde’s cedar to Hester; a moment of fury.
